days.label: Saturday
days.text: Saturday is the fullest day of the weekend. Our own BTown Coffee Club [MEETUP] runs 10 to noon at Zero Gravity on Pine Street, free as always, so grab a coffee and find us. The Burlington Farmers Market is up from 9 to 2 further down Pine Street, Festival of Fools picks back up at 11 for its closing day, and the Fool’s Gold Book Sale spreads out on the Fletcher Free lawn from 10 with most books at $2. Early risers have the Green Mountain Club’s Camels Hump Loop [MEETUP] stepping off at 7:30, though sign ups for that one have already closed. Runners can lace up for the KW Fun Run/Walk 5K on Randall Street at 10 to benefit Green Mountain Habitat for Humanity, gardeners can put in a shift at the Miner Garden Workday at the UVM horticulture farm in South Burlington from 10, and naturalists can join Community Phenology at Rock Point at 10:30. If your speed is quieter, James Kochalka reads at Phoenix Books at 11, Board Game Brunch [MEETUP] settles in at Old Town Cafe in Williston from 9, and the Vermont Psychic Expo takes over the Champlain Valley Expo from 10 to 5. COTS Back to School Bonanza fills the lot at 95 North Avenue from noon to 3. The evening splits between The Head and the Heart w/ Houndmouth ($58, kids 12 and under free) at Waterfront Park, Swing Dance with Emily Day and Friends at North Star with a lesson at 7, ‘No Exit’ at 2 and again at 7:30 at the Off Center, and the Fools’ Twilight Series sending the festival off with Milton Busker & the Grim Work at 6 and The Wolff Sisters at 7:30. And Vermont Green plays for the national title at 7:30, away in Flint and live on WCAX.

days.label: Sunday
days.text: Sunday works best if you get out early. Trio Nuovo opens with free classical at the BCA Center at 10, the Winooski Farmers Market runs 10 to 2, and Mix & Mingle [MEETUP] holds down the afternoon at the Boardroom from noon. Sunday Polo in Shelburne opens its gates at 2:30 for a 3 o’clock match, and Champ’s Birthday Bash brings the Lake Monsters out against Lowell at 5:05, with the first 500 fans getting a cooler. Rock Point hosts “Offerings and Needs” at the fire pit behind the chapel from 4:30, the Queer Clothing Swap runs 5 to 8 at the Hunny Hive on Church Street, and Womxn’s Pick-up Soccer [MEETUP] could use bodies at Starr Farm Park at 5. The night belongs to Big Thief w/ Ben LaMar Gay at Waterfront Park, which is sold out with a wait list going, Aaron Chen: TECHNOLOGY ($25) at Vermont Comedy Club at 7, and Reversal of Man with NØ MAN, Blossom and CORRUPT WORLD at Radio Bean at 7:30.
